JarvanIV.teamfight: From the flank, hit multiple enemies with Lillia Q Blooming Blows to apply Dream Dust instead of trying to land the center of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! from the front. If you have a chance to start a teamfight, apply Dream Dust beforehand, then use Lillia R Lilting Lullaby from out of sight. Coordinate with your allies on the order and wake sleeping targets one at a time.

Nidalee.build: Build magic resistance first to counter the damage from Nidalee Q Javelin Toss / Takedown and Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce.
Nidalee.combo: Dodge Nidalee’s spears and traps, then slow her first with Lillia E Swirlseed. Next, aim for the center of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! and finish with Lillia Q Blooming Blows. To use Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, hit an ability first to apply Dream Dust, and check whether your allies can wait for the sleep to take effect.
Nidalee.escape: Look for a chance to close the gap right after Nidalee uses the Pounce from Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce. Use Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! to close in, but aim for the center after slowing her with Lillia E Swirlseed. Nidalee has no crowd control, so when you need to create distance again, use Lillia Q Blooming Blows’ movement speed stacks and the slow from Lillia E Swirlseed.
Nidalee.fight: Before a fight, hit a camp or minion with Lillia Q Blooming Blows to build movement speed stacks. After dodging Nidalee’s spears and traps, deal damage from the side with Lillia Q Blooming Blows. If Nidalee tries to close in, slow her with Lillia E Swirlseed.
Nidalee.laning: Early on, clear camps in quick succession instead of hunting for kills with solo ganks. Check jungle entrances and the river for Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce traps with a Control Ward or an area ability before entering. When ganking, wait for the opponent to step toward the inside of the lane, then roll Lillia E Swirlseed along the wall.
Nidalee.phase: Early on, focus on clearing and scaling, and avoid letting Nidalee’s spears and traps disrupt your path through the jungle. In the mid to late game, use Lillia’s damage over time and movement speed to fight from the side.
Nidalee.teamfight: Instead of standing in front and taking Nidalee’s spears, hit multiple enemies with Lillia Q Blooming Blows from the side to apply Dream Dust. If Nidalee dives in, slow her with Lillia E Swirlseed to create distance between her and your carries, and remember where she stood when throwing a spear. If Lillia R Lilting Lullaby puts multiple enemies to sleep, coordinate with your allies on the targets and focus them one at a time to wake them.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee’s spear from Nidalee Q Javelin Toss / Takedown deals more damage the farther it travels, so be especially careful to dodge it when she throws from a distance. Watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce traps on jungle entrances and in the river too. If you’re hit by a spear or trap and marked for the hunt, save Lillia E Swirlseed to deal with Nidalee’s Pounce and Q Takedown.

Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first to handle Rammus’s main ability damage. Since Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl greatly increases his resistance, prioritize percentage penetration over flat penetration.
Rammus.combo: Slow the target first with Lillia E Swirlseed, then hit the center of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! and finish with Lillia Q Blooming Blows. If Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, delay your damage sequence and look for an angle to land Lillia E Swirlseed from outside Rammus E Frenzying Taunt range.
Rammus.escape: When Rammus R Soaring Slam is down, that’s your chance to engage. If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is down too, you can close the gap with Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!. If you’re taunted, account for using your mobility spell as soon as it ends.
Rammus.fight: Keep your distance while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, then focus your damage as soon as it ends. Keep landing Lillia Q Blooming Blows to stack movement speed and aim for the true damage at its edge. Don’t cast Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! first to engage head-on while within Rammus E Frenzying Taunt range.
Rammus.laning: Early on, clear camps quickly and scale instead of forcing kills. Before a gank, hit a camp or minion with Lillia Q Blooming Blows to stack movement speed. If the enemy moves toward the inside of the lane, roll Lillia E Swirlseed along the wall.
Rammus.phase: Early on, Lillia should focus on fast jungle clears and scaling, and avoid forcing solo ganks. In the mid and late game, make use of Lillia’s strengths as her damage over time and movement speed improve, while looking for windows when Rammus R Soaring Slam is down.
Rammus.teamfight: From the flank, hit multiple enemies with Lillia Q Blooming Blows to apply Dream Dust, then hit the engaging Rammus with Lillia E Swirlseed to create space between him and your allied carries. Use Lillia R Lilting Lullaby after applying Dream Dust before a teamfight, when your allies can wait for the sleep. Coordinate with your team to focus and wake sleeping enemies one at a time.
Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus approaching with Rammus Q Powerball, keep minions between you and him and stay outside Rammus E Frenzying Taunt range. Dodge Rammus R Soaring Slam, cast after he builds speed with Rammus Q Powerball, with plenty of room, then move away from the landing point immediately. When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, don’t dump your damage into him; wait for it to end.

Sejuani.build: When buying defensive stats, build magic resistance first for the magic damage from Sejuani P Fury of the North, Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, and Sejuani E Permafrost. Sejuani P Fury of the North also deals percent max-health damage, so don’t rely on a large amount of health alone.
Sejuani.combo: If Sejuani’s Frost Armor from Sejuani P Fury of the North is active, damage her first with Lillia Q Blooming Blows, then hit her with Lillia E Swirlseed once her slow immunity wears off shortly afterward. While she’s slowed, aim for the center hit of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, then finish with Lillia Q Blooming Blows. Use Lillia R Lilting Lullaby after applying Dream Dust with a spell, when your allies can wait for the sleep to take effect.
Sejuani.escape: Right after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down is your chance to engage; close the gap with Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!. If you’re stunned by Sejuani E Permafrost, create distance as soon as it ends to dodge her follow-up basic attack that deals percent max-health damage.
Sejuani.fight: Keep landing Lillia Q Blooming Blows to maintain movement speed stacks, and use its edge’s true damage against Sejuani’s high defensive stats. When Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, close the gap with Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, but aim for its center hit after the slow is applied. If you’re hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, get out before the second strike.
Sejuani.laning: Early on, clear camps quickly instead of forcing solo ganks. Catch the monster group with the edge of Lillia Q Blooming Blows and hit the large monster with the center of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! to keep your route moving. Before a gank, hit a camp or minion with Lillia Q Blooming Blows to build movement speed stacks, then roll Lillia E Swirlseed along the wall once the enemy moves toward the inside of the lane.
Sejuani.phase: Early on, Lillia clears the jungle quickly but has weak solo ganks, so prioritize scaling and your camp route. While Sejuani’s early kill and damage metrics are low, look for jungle control and objectives to delay her item timings.
Sejuani.teamfight: From the flank, hit multiple enemies with Lillia Q Blooming Blows instead of aiming for the center of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! from the front. If Sejuani engages, create distance with Lillia E Swirlseed, and move sideways to dodge Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison. Before using Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, apply Dream Dust before the fight and cast it from out of vision. Coordinate with your allies to choose a target and wake sleeping enemies one at a time.
Sejuani.watch: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison can lead into crowd control, so move sideways to dodge when you see their tell. If you’re hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, get out of range before its second strike, which deals high damage and slows. Melee allies near Sejuani can also build Sejuani E Permafrost stacks, so immediately create distance when they start to build up.

Skarner.build: Decide first whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build to counter suppression from Skarner R Impale. Consider magic resistance first for his damage, but it won’t block the physical damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval or Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Since he deals percent max-health damage, prioritize movement speed to leave telegraphed areas instead of building only health.
Skarner.combo: Slow the target first with Lillia E Swirlseed, hit the center of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, then finish with Lillia Q Blooming Blows. Before casting Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, hit with a spell to apply Dream Dust, and cast it when your allies can wait for the sleep.
Skarner.escape: Right after you’ve baited out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is your window to engage. Close the gap with Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, while staying alert so you don’t enter the short range of Skarner R Impale.
Skarner.fight: Before Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, build movement speed by landing Lillia Q Blooming Blows at its edge and avoid melee range. Right after Skarner uses Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, you have an opening to close the gap with Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!. Avoid fights where Skarner keeps hitting you with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval.
Skarner.laning: Early on, clear camps quickly instead of looking for kills with solo ganks. Catch the monster group with the edge of Lillia Q Blooming Blows and hit the large monster with the center of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!. Before a gank, hit a camp or minion with Lillia Q Blooming Blows to build movement speed, then roll Lillia E Swirlseed along the wall once the enemy moves toward the inside of the lane.
Skarner.teamfight: From the flank, hit multiple enemies with Lillia Q Blooming Blows to apply Dream Dust, then slow the engaging Skarner with Lillia E Swirlseed to create space between him and your allied carries. If possible, hit with Lillia Q Blooming Blows or Lillia E Swirlseed before the teamfight, then cast Lillia R Lilting Lullaby from out of vision. Coordinate with your allies to focus and wake sleeping enemies one at a time.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact passes through terrain, and you’ll be stunned if you hit a wall after being grabbed, so don’t stand with your back to a wall. Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! can’t free you from suppression by Skarner R Impale, so stay out of its short range. Don’t let Skarner get into melee range, where he can hit you with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval.

Udyr.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Udyr deals mostly physical damage, and Lillia has low armor, so build armor first.
Udyr.combo: Slow Udyr first with Lillia E Swirlseed, then aim for the center of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! and finish with Lillia Q Blooming Blows. To use Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, first hit him with a spell to apply Dream Dust, and cast it when your allies can wait for the sleep to take effect.
Udyr.escape: Right after you make Udyr use Udyr E Blazing Stampede, you have an opening to close the gap with Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! If Udyr E Blazing Stampede stuns you once, counterattack or escape while that same target cannot be stunned again for a while. Immobilizing effects do not work while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is empowered, so wait until the empowerment ends before trying to sleep him with Lillia R Lilting Lullaby.
Udyr.fight: Keep landing Lillia Q Blooming Blows to stack movement speed, and trade with its outer edge’s true damage. Once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle wears off, slow him with Lillia E Swirlseed and chase him down. Aim for the center of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! after he is slowed or asleep.
Udyr.laning: Early on, clear camps back to back quickly instead of trying to get kills with solo ganks. Hit the edge of Lillia Q Blooming Blows across a group of monsters and hit the large monster with the center of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! Before a gank, hit a camp or minion with Lillia Q Blooming Blows to build movement speed stacks. If the enemy moves toward the inner part of the lane, roll Lillia E Swirlseed along the wall.
Udyr.phase: Lillia clears and scales well early, but has weak solo ganks, so prioritize camps. Lillia is strongest in the mid to late game, when items improve her damage over time and movement speed.
Udyr.teamfight: Instead of facing Udyr head-on, approach from the flank and apply Dream Dust to multiple enemies with Lillia Q Blooming Blows. If Udyr engages, slow him with Lillia E Swirlseed to create space between him and your allied damage dealers, and target weaker enemies behind him before the durable Udyr. To start a team fight, apply Dream Dust from a distance with Lillia Q Blooming Blows or Lillia E Swirlseed, then cast Lillia R Lilting Lullaby from out of sight.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede closes distance quickly and stuns the first target it hits, so keep your distance right after Udyr switches stances. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on your health alone when trading with him.

Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress. Also get armor to defend against his basic attack damage. If the duel drags on, consider Grievous Wounds next to reduce Warwick’s healing.
Warwick.combo: Before a gank, hit a camp or minion with Lillia Q Blooming Blows to build movement speed stacks. After the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl goes off, slow him with Lillia E Swirlseed, hit the center of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, then finish with Lillia Q Blooming Blows. To use Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, first hit him with a spell to apply Dream Dust, and check that your allies can wait for him to fall asleep.
Warwick.escape: Don’t engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down. There is an opening to engage if Warwick R Infinite Duress is not back yet and the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl has already gone off. Close the gap with Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! then, but aim for its center after Lillia E Swirlseed slows him.
Warwick.fight: Keep landing Lillia Q Blooming Blows to stack movement speed, use its outer edge’s true damage, and maintain distance. While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, don’t try to deal heavy damage; back off and fight again once the fear goes off. Even at low health, Warwick has strong healing, so don’t dive in based on his health alone.
Warwick.laning: Early on, clear camps quickly one after another to scale instead of forcing kills. Clear by hitting the edge of Lillia Q Blooming Blows across a group of monsters and hitting the large monster with the center of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!. If health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your location, so don’t stay in the jungle after losing a lot of health.
Warwick.phase: Lillia excels at clearing and scaling in the early game, but has weak solo ganks, so focus on cycling through camps. Warwick clears slowly early, giving you a chance to gain an advantage through lane priority; however, if you give him an early kill, Warwick W Blood Hunt makes the game difficult to play.
Warwick.teamfight: Instead of aiming for the center of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! from the front, approach from the flank and apply Dream Dust to multiple enemies with Lillia Q Blooming Blows. If Warwick approaches your allied damage dealers, create distance with the slow from Lillia E Swirlseed. If you put multiple enemies to sleep with Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, coordinate with your allies on the targets and focus on waking them one at a time.
Warwick.watch: Warwick R Infinite Duress suppresses you if it hits, so watch out for long-range leaps when Warwick’s movement speed is increased. When Warwick activates Warwick E Primal Howl, the damage he takes is reduced and fear follows, so slow him with Lillia E Swirlseed while creating distance. Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast can also close the gap, so don’t get close while it is available.

XinZhao.build: Xin Zhao deals mostly physical damage, and Lillia has low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots.
XinZhao.combo: Slow Xin Zhao first with Lillia E Swirlseed, then aim for the center of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! and finish with Lillia Q Blooming Blows. To use Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, first hit him with a spell to apply Dream Dust, and cast it when your allies can wait for the sleep to take effect.
XinZhao.escape: Right after you make Xin Zhao use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, you have an opening to close the gap with Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!. If Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike has hit you twice with empowered basic attacks, don’t engage; get away with Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! or Flash before the third hit.
XinZhao.fight: Keep landing Lillia Q Blooming Blows to stack movement speed, and deal damage with its outer edge. After sidestepping the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning and making him use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, you have an opening to close the gap with Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, create distance and counterattack once his immunity ends.
XinZhao.laning: Early on, clear camps back to back quickly instead of trying to get kills with solo ganks. Hit the edge of Lillia Q Blooming Blows across a group of monsters and hit the large monster with the center of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!. When ganking, hit a camp or minion with Lillia Q Blooming Blows to build movement speed. If the enemy moves toward the inner part of the lane, roll Lillia E Swirlseed along the wall.
XinZhao.phase: Lillia clears and scales well early, but has weak solo ganks, so prioritize camps. Lillia is strongest in the mid to late game, when items improve her damage over time and movement speed. In late game team fights, look to counterattack the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.teamfight: From the flank, apply Dream Dust to multiple enemies with Lillia Q Blooming Blows, and hit an engaging Xin Zhao with Lillia E Swirlseed to create space between him and your allied damage dealers. Cast Lillia R Lilting Lullaby from out of sight before the team fight, then coordinate with your allies on the target and wake sleeping enemies one at a time, focusing them together. Counterattack once Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.watch: Sidestep the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning. If Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike has hit you twice with empowered basic attacks, move out of range with Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! or Flash before the third hit knocks you up. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, don’t try to damage him from outside his spear’s range.

Zac.build: Prioritize items that improve movement speed, since the movement speed from Lillia Q Blooming Blows can help you leave Zac’s telegraphed engage area. If you build resistances, choose magic resistance to match Zac’s damage; don’t prioritize options that only add armor or health.
Zac.combo: First slow Zac with Lillia E Swirlseed, then hit the center of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! and finish with Lillia Q Blooming Blows. To use Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, first hit him with a spell to apply Dream Dust, and cast it when your allies can wait for the sleep to take effect.
Zac.escape: Right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down is your chance to close the gap. If Zac Q Stretching Strikes’ crowd control is also down, slow him with Lillia E Swirlseed and engage with Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!. Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! cannot cross terrain, so don’t cast it directly at Zac through a wall.
Zac.fight: Keep landing Lillia Q Blooming Blows to stack movement speed, and fight at its outer edge’s true damage range to maintain distance. When Zac tries to get close, slow him with Lillia E Swirlseed, then back away to avoid damage from Zac W Unstable Matter. Walk over the blobs from Zac P Cell Division as you pass to prevent him from healing.
Zac.laning: Early on, clear camps back to back instead of forcing solo ganks. Hit the edge of Lillia Q Blooming Blows across a group of monsters and hit the large monster with the center of Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!. Before a gank, hit a camp or minion with Lillia Q Blooming Blows to build movement speed. If the enemy moves toward the inner part of the lane, roll Lillia E Swirlseed along the wall.
Zac.phase: Lillia is strongest in the mid to late game, when items improve her damage over time and movement speed. The available information isn’t enough to assess when Zac is stronger or weaker.
Zac.teamfight: From the flank, apply Dream Dust to multiple enemies with Lillia Q Blooming Blows, and hit an engaging Zac with Lillia E Swirlseed to create space between him and your allied damage dealers. If possible, apply Dream Dust before the fight, then cast Lillia R Lilting Lullaby from out of sight. Coordinate with your allies on the targets and wake sleeping enemies one at a time. Walk over the blobs from Zac P Cell Division to prevent him from healing, and decide whether to fight after checking if his revival is available.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot charges before dashing in and knocking you up, so if you see him charging behind a wall, move away from where he will land. If Zac Q Stretching Strikes slows and knocks you up, it is difficult to create distance; if you stay close, you also take damage from Zac W Unstable Matter based on your maximum health.
